ambiguous_source_mark.meaning: Conservative token for a narrow vertical/slanted stroke immediately before VAADA; not an identification of a printed pipe character or a cipher coordinate.

analysis_frame.scope: The ambiguous stroke is treated as an extra noncoordinate mark and one missing coordinate is hypothesized at the end. This is an explicit conditional frame, not a native reading.

headers: C) UKS RAT v NKJ (10.32 p.m., November 6th, 1918.)
Cleartext ending: B M K - UKS RAT v NKJ UM
limits: The transcription counts the ambiguous narrow stroke before VAADA as one masked source slot, giving 286 slots and matching the advertisement. Its native decode is preserved in full.
The readable proposal explicitly excludes that one masked mark and adds one coordinate slot at the end. The source does not show a cancellation or a blank establishing either operation.
With that mark excluded and the stated partial candidate fixed, every single-gap alignment is priced; a lowest price establishes compatibility only within that family, not historical uniqueness.
The ordinary-word proposal uses three observed substitutions, four source-mask fills and one added-slot fill. Two unresolved plaintext positions remain.
HZYU, KIE? and O?MANIE stay literal; the edition does not identify them from historical geography, expand all abbreviations or invent a reason for the reported failure.
The published Nov4–6 key and all retained source order remain unchanged. One excluded masked mark is counted separately from observed substitutions and supplied coordinates.
Earlier key recovery and repository work retain credit. This is a conditional source restoration, not a first decipherment.

source_evidence_delivery.default_verification: Source transcription, cryptographic arithmetic, local PNG bytes and RGB hashes are checked. Comparison with source-PDF pixels requires --pdf.
source_evidence_delivery.original_pdf_verification: With --pdf, verify the complete PDF byte count and SHA-256, then compare both rendered crops with their recorded RGB hashes and embedded PNG pixels.
